🔥 Tired of fighting Cloudflare blocks, managing proxies, and parsing messy HTML just to feed data to your LLM? 

Building AI agents and RAG pipelines shouldn't require spending weeks writing custom web scrapers. That is why Firecrawl is exploding in the developer community right now. 

Firecrawl instantly transforms chaotic, JavaScript-heavy web pages, PDFs, and docs into clean, token-efficient markdown or strict JSON schemas. It completely bypasses rate limits, handles rendering, and lets you feed real-time web data directly into your AI stack with minimal configuration.

🚀 Key Features:
• AI-Powered Autonomous Agent: Gather information and return structured data using natural language prompts without needing predefined URLs.
• LLM-Ready & Media Parsing: Instantly clean and format web pages, PDFs, and DOCX files into markdown or JSON.
• Interactive Browser Actions: Programmatically or AI-drive pages to click, scroll, fill forms, and execute complex workflows.
• Native AI Ecosystem Integration: Out-of-the-box support for MCP (Model Context Protocol) clients and CLI developer skills.

Whether you are building real-time web-aware AI agents or automating large-scale data harvesting pipelines, Firecrawl saves you serious engineering time. 

👉 Check out the repo and drop a star to support the project:
https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl

Production AI agents fail in unpredictable ways. Manually writing speculative test datasets to catch those bugs is a massive bottleneck. 

Enter Tracely: Turn unpredictable production AI agent failures into zero-cost, hermetic regression tests and block bad code in CI. 🚀

Tracely bridges the gap between production observability and testing by automatically ingesting and grading production agent traces. It clusters failures into actionable issues, freezes failing runs into hermetic regression test fixtures, and stops bad pull requests right in their tracks.

Here is what makes it a game-changer for AI engineering teams:

⚡ Trace-Native CI/CD Gates: Replay recorded failure fixtures in CI offline with zero model spend and zero API keys required, blocking pull requests via strict pass/fail contracts.
🧠 Automated Failure Clustering: Group erratic agent trace errors using structural signatures and semantic embeddings into actionable issues with auto-suggested evaluators.
📦 Hermetic Regression Case Promotion: Instantly promote a real failing trace into a packaged test bundle complete with recorded inputs, tool calls, and LLM outputs.
📊 Visual Alert Flows & Evaluations: Combine real-time SSE-streamed LLM judges directly on trace tables with a visual node-based canvas for custom conditional alerting workflows.

Stop wasting time and money hand-authoring LLM test datasets. Get high-fidelity safety guarantees for your non-deterministic agent code at zero token cost.

👉 Check it out on GitHub: https://github.com/jwuthri-cloud/Tracely-ai

Tired of unstable Wi-Fi and slow hotel connections? net-merge lets you combine your Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and phone tethering simultaneously into a single aggregated pipe across macOS, Windows, and Linux without a VPN or server. 🚀

Developers and remote workers know the frustration of dealing with a single, spotty internet connection while trying to pull massive multi-gigabyte container images, sync large cloud repos, or fetch heavy vendor dependencies. 

net-merge solves this by pooling multiple active network adapters together. It dynamically balances and spreads out concurrent TCP and UDP connections across all available interfaces, aggregating your bandwidth completely locally—no paid VPN subscription, proxy, or external server required. 💻⚡

Notable Features:
• Per-connection multi-link load balancing that distributes traffic based on interface speed and automatically ignores dead links until they recover
• Seamless cross-platform system tray and menu bar integration supporting Windows, macOS Universal binaries, and a wide array of Linux distributions
• Zero-configuration design with no mandatory user accounts, keeping your data private and local
• Ultra-lightweight architecture consuming only about 0.18 CPU cores per 100 Mbit/s, with graceful fail-safe behavior if the app ever crashes

Whether you are combining wired Ethernet with a mobile USB tether to slash download times or ensuring uninterrupted remote workflow continuity during unstable network drops, this tool is built for your stack.

Check out the repo and drop a star to support the project:
https://github.com/rohit267/net-merge

🎮 Ever wonder how to run PlayStation 4 console exclusives natively on Windows without heavy full-system emulation? 

Check out uncharted_pc! This incredible open-source project lets you run the PS4 Uncharted collection directly on your Windows 10 or 11 PC by executing original game binaries on the host CPU and piping graphics straight through Vulkan. 🚀

🧩 The Problem It Solves:
It breaks down console exclusivity walls by taking original PS4 game binaries, translating the graphics API calls, and wrapping proprietary platform subsystems so they can execute seamlessly on standard x86_64 hardware.

🔥 Notable Features:
• Native binary execution on Windows with high-performance Vulkan graphics translation
• Built-in support for advanced upscaling and frame generation including AMD FSR 3.1, FSR 4, NVIDIA DLSS, and DLAA
• A unified launcher supporting all three titles with customized input mapping, high refresh rates up to 120+ FPS, and native desktop integration
• Low-level systems workarounds, like instruction emulation for older CPUs and custom graphics pipeline synchronization

💻 Why Developers Need to See This:
For systems engineers, reverse engineers, and graphics programmers, this repository is an absolute masterclass in modern hardware abstraction and graphics translation. Dive into the code to see how to bridge proprietary console runtimes with modern PC upscaling, manage memory via Vulkan Memory Allocator, and handle CPU instruction discrepancies.

👉 Explore the repo and check out the source code here:
https://github.com/Supermedo/uncharted_pc

Turn your laggy, ad-infested Smart TV into a clean, lightning-fast setup with an Apple TV-inspired interface! 📺⚡

Most Android TVs ship with sluggish interfaces, aggressive manufacturer telemetry, and unskippable ads that drain limited hardware resources. 

tv-vibehack is an open-source, zero-root debloating toolkit and custom launcher built specifically to reclaim your TV's performance. 

Key features include:
🐍 Pure-Python ADB Client: A standalone Python script replacing standard binaries to handle network operations smoothly.
🛡️ Reversible Debloating: Safely disables bloatware and ads using pm disable-user without permanent uninstallation.
🚀 Ultra-Lightweight Launcher: A tiny 1.6 MB Java application designed for 1 GB RAM systems with zero background services.
🤖 AI-Assisted Discovery: Integrates prompts for LLM coding assistants to safely map out model-specific package bloat.

Whether you are looking for production-ready patterns in programmatic ADB automation, cross-platform provisioning utilities, or clean-room Android UI design for constrained hardware, this repository is worth a star.

Check it out and drop your feedback here:
https://github.com/Gathin23/tv-vibehack
